description: This file defines the PimCsvDataImportService class responsible for importing CSV data related to Employee Information Management in the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods for configuring and using an underlying CsvDataImportService to process employee data CSV files.

classes.name: PimCsvDataImportService
classes.description: Service class for importing employee data from CSV files, utilizing CsvDataImportService.

methods.name: getCsvDataImportService
methods.description: Returns the CsvDataImportService instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: setCsvDataImportService
methods.description: Sets the CsvDataImportService instance used by this service.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Executes the import process for a given CSV file content, specifically for PIM data.
